interval.availability_rule: The archived FOMC statement explicitly says 'For release at 2:00 p.m.' with an EST or EDT abbreviation. FinReplay validates that abbreviation against America/New_York on the named release date and converts the timestamp to UTC.

claim_boundary: This lock preserves the May 3, 2023 archived FOMC statement's 525-basis-point upper target endpoint solely as a post-decision official event marker. Its knowledge time is the page's explicit 2:00 p.m. EDT release time. The fact is excluded from ReplayPack inputs and does not establish forecast skill, calibrated coverage, monetary-policy correctness or causal effects, policy or investment performance, external review, deployment, or user impact.
